_notes: 10 pages. A short traction-and-product deck: user metrics, a growth chart, press wall, geography, app-store ratings and a pricing slide. Strong on usage numbers, silent on the company itself - no revenue, no team, no HQ, no ask. No investor is named anywhere (the logo wall is press coverage, not backers), and the deck states no date - Dec '12 and Jul '13 are only axis labels on the growth chart.

one_liner.value: The only way to organize your life and work

expected_flags.note: pricing is shown ($4.99/mo, $49.99/yr, team plans) but no revenue, no paying-user count and no free-to-paid conversion rate
no round size, ask or use of funds anywhere in the deck
no team slide; no founder or employee is named
deck never states HQ or country; the geography slide covers user distribution only

metrics slide claims '500,000 daily active users' while the growth chart two slides later shows daily actives at 450k in Jul '13; the same slide's '4x DAU growth within 6 months' is charted as Dec '12 (120k) to Jul '13 (450k), i.e. 3.75x over seven months
'category leader' and 'we are the owner of Tasks' asserted with no market size, share data or source; no competitor in task management is named
